title: Apple raises iPhone prices in Japan by up to 11%, likely due to the Japanese yen's depreciation against the US dollar over the past year (Joe Rossignol/MacRumors)
summary: Joe Rossignol / MacRumors: Apple raises iPhone prices in Japan by up to 11%, likely due to the Japanese yen's depreciation against the US dollar over the past year — After raising prices on all Macs and iPads worldwide last month, Apple has now increased the price of iPhone models in Japan.
